ActionRow.name: ActionRow
ActionRow.description:
A layout utility for the common use case of aligning buttons, links or text
in a row in a control bar or nav.

ActionRow assumes that its last child is the primary action and lays out actions so that the last item is in a primary location. If horizontal, the primary action sits on the right. If stacked, the primary action sits at the top of the stack (this is done via `flex-direction: column-reverse;`).

Alert.name: Alert
Alert.description:
The `Alert` component displays a short, important message in a way that attracts the user's attention. Alerts offer four severity levels that set a distinctive icon and color: - **Info**: used to convey general information or actions that aren't critical, note that info variant should not contain any icons in it - **Warning**: used to display information that needs attention - **Success**: used for success messages - **Danger**: used to communicate problems that have to be resolved immediately This component utilizes and extends the `Alert` component from react-bootstrap.
See React-Bootstrap for additional documentation.

props.name: bsPrefix

props.name: variant

props.name: transition

props.name: icon

props.name: show
props.description: Whether the alert is shown.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Whether the alert is dismissible. Defaults to false.

props.name: actions
props.description: Optional list of action elements. May include, at most, 2 actions, or 1 if dismissible is true.

props.name: stacked
props.description: Position of the dismiss and call-to-action buttons. Defaults to `false`.

props.name: closeLabel
props.description: Sets the text for alert close button, defaults to 'Dismiss'.

props.name: as
props.description: Specifies the base element

events.name: onClose
events.description: Optional callback function for when the alert it dismissed.

Card.name: Card
Card.description:
`Card` is a box of related content usually describing a single object. It can be composed of several subcomponents, we give full overview of those subcomponents below.

`Card` supports `vertical` and `horizontal` orientation which is controlled by `CardContext`, see examples below.

props.name: className
props.description: The class name for the CardDeck component

props.name: children
props.description: The Card components to organize

props.name: columnSizes
props.description: An object containing the desired column size at each breakpoint, following a similar props API as ``react-bootstrap/Col``

props.name: hasInteractiveChildren
props.description: Whether the child `Card` components are interactive/focusable. If not, a `tabindex="0"` is added to be a11y-compliant

props.name: canScrollHorizontal
props.description: Whether the `CardDeck` supports horizontal scrolling when there are overflow children

props.name: hasOverflowScrollItems
props.description: Whether the children of CardDeck should be processed by `useOverflowScrollItems` to give each child a known/stable CSS classname

props.name: hasEqualColumnHeights
props.description: Whether to disable the default equal height cards

props.name: textElement
props.description: Optional node to display near actions. Should be either a plain text or an element containing text (e.g. link).

props.name: isStacked
props.description: Specifies whether to use stacked variant.

props.name: orientation
props.description: Specifies which orientation to use. This prop will override context value if provided.

props.name: skeletonHeight
props.description: Specifies height of skeleton in loading state.

props.name: skeletonWidth
props.description: Specifies width of skeleton in loading state.

props.name: actions
props.description: Optional node to render on the top right of the card header, i.e. ActionRow or a DropdownMenu.

props.name: title
props.description: The title for the CardHeader component

props.name: size
props.description: The size of the CardHeader component

props.name: subtitle
props.description: The subtitle of the CardHeader component

props.name: src
props.description: Specifies image src.

props.name: fallbackSrc
props.description: Specifies fallback image src.

props.name: srcAlt
props.description: Specifies image alt text.

props.name: logoSrc
props.description: Specifies logo src to put on top of the image.

props.name: fallbackLogoSrc
props.description: Specifies fallback image logo src.

props.name: logoAlt
props.description: Specifies logo image alt text.

props.name: logoSkeleton
props.description: Specifies whether the cap should be displayed during loading.

props.name: logoSkeletonHeight
props.description: Specifies height of Logo skeleton in loading state.

props.name: logoSkeletonWidth
props.description: Specifies width of Logo skeleton in loading state.

props.name: imageLoadingType
props.description: Specifies loading type for images

props.name: skeletonDuringImageLoad
props.description: Render the loading skeleton when the image is loading in addition to when the whole card is in `isLoading` state

props.name: muted
props.description: Specifies whether to display `Section` with muted styling.

props.name: variant
props.description: Specifies variant to use.

props.name: isClickable
props.description: Specifies whether the `Card` is clickable, if `true` appropriate `hover` and `focus` styling will be added.

props.name: isLoading
props.description: Specifies loading state.

events.name: icon
events.description: Icon that will be shown in the top-left corner.

Dropzone.name: Dropzone
Dropzone.description:
The `Dropzone` allows users to upload files via drag and drop, or by clicking the component. Currently, only one file upload at a time is allowed.

You will also need to provide upload logic yourself via `onProcessUpload` prop which accepts function that should take care of uploading the file to the backend (i.e. send HTTP request). 
This function accepts an object with following content as its only argument:
- \{object\} fileData - Metadata about the uploaded file.
- \{object\} requestConfig - Config to pass to `axios` call (this is required to display progress bar and hande cancel action).
- \{function\} handleError - Function to communicate to `Dropzone` that file upload resulted in failure, expects `Error` object as its only argument.

Each example below implements such a function.

**Note** that `Dropzone` does not render file after successful upload, you will have to provide that logic yourself depending on which type of file has been uploaded, see [this example](#with-file-preview).

props.name: className
props.description: Specifies class name to append to the base element.

props.name: accept
props.description: Set accepted file types. This should be an object with the keys set to the [MIME type](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTTP/Basics_of_HTTP/MIME_types/Common_types) and the values to an array of file extensions.

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Maximum file size (in bytes).

props.name: minSize
props.description: Minimum file size (in bytes).

props.name: errorMessages
props.description: An object containing error messages, following are supported: 1) invalidType - A message to display when file of invalid type is dropped into `Dropzone`. Defaults to 'The file type must be {filType} file / one of {fileTypes} files.'. 2) invalidSizeLess - A message to display when file of size less than minSize value is dropped into `Dropzone`. Defaults to 'File must be larger than {minSize}.'. 3) invalidSizeMore - A message to display when file of size greater than maxSize value is dropped into `Dropzone`. Defaults to 'File must be less than {maxSize}.'. 4) multipleDragged - A message to display when multiple files are dragged over `Dropzone`. 5) uploadError - A message to display in case upload results in an error

props.name: progressVariant
props.description: Specifies how the upload progress should be displayed, component shows either spinner or a progress bar.

props.name: inputComponent
props.description: A component to display initial state of the `Dropzone`.

events.name: onUploadProgress
events.description: A callback fired each time an upload progress event happens, receives (percentageUploaded, progressEvent) as arguments.

events.name: onUploadCancel
events.description: A callback fired upon successful upload, receives Response object as a single argument.

events.name: onProcessUpload
events.description: A function responsible for uploading the file. Receives following object as its only argument { @param {object} fileData - Metadata about the uploaded file. @param {object} requestConfig - Config to pass to `axios` call. @param {function} handleError - Function to communicate to `Dropzone` that file upload resulted in failure, expects `Error` object to be passed as its only argument. }

events.name: validator
events.description: Custom validation function, receives `File` object as its only argument. Note that this function will be invoked as a last validation step before beginning an upload process.

SearchField.name: SearchField
SearchField.description: Search allows users to quickly find content. The ``Search field`` is made up of the ``Text field`` component and an optional ``Button`` component.

props.name: children
props.description: specifies the nested child elements. At a minimum, `SearchField.Label` and `SearchField.Input` are required.

events.name: onClear

events.name: onFocus
